title: 1000V DC | 10x38 Solar PV Fuse Base | DIN Rail Mount for Solar Panels, Combiner Boxes, Inverters & Battery Backup Systems (1 Pole DC Fuse)
description: The GADITES GAD-32HX DC Fuse Holder is a premium-quality solar protection component designed specifically for high-voltage DC applications including photovoltaic systems, combiner boxes, solar inverters, battery backup systems, and industrial DC circuits. Rated for 1000V DC and 32A, this fuse holder delivers safe and reliable circuit protection against overloads and short circuits in renewable energy installations. The compact DIN rail mounting design enables fast installation inside electrical panels and solar distribution systems. The GAD-32HX supports standard 10x38mm DC fuse links, making maintenance simple and replacement convenient. Its flame-resistant housing and high-conductivity internal contacts ensure stable electrical performance and long-term durability in demanding environments. Whether for residential rooftop solar systems or large-scale commercial PV installations, GADITES provides trusted professional-grade DC protection engineered for safety, reliability, and performance.
